instruction: Apply both underline and bold formatting to the titles on slides 3, 5, and 6.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making titles in slides 3, 5, and 6 both underlined and bold. Evaluator uses custom getter to extract title formatting (bold and underline status) from specified slides and custom metric to verify all three slides have correct formatting. Slide titles are: Slide 3='Add a Roadmap Page', Slide 5='Write your topic or idea', Slide 6='Write an original statement or inspiring quote'.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Each correctly formatted slide contributes 1/3 to the final score (partial credit enabled)

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: slides 3, 5, and 6 with both bold and underline formatting

Proper data flow: getter returns dict mapping slide_idx to formatting info, metric compares each slide's actual vs expected formatting
Appropriate postconfig present: activates window and saves file (Ctrl+S) to ensure PPTX is saved before getter reads it
